story.title: Learning the ropes
story.about: Someone's showing you how things work here: making friends, the card shop, quests, time, your deck, and a first duel.

objectives.text: Finish the tour with your guide

endings.title: Lesson learned
endings.scene: World: Story, C1 After the lesson

story.title: Champion of the arena
story.about: {mentor} says to come back once you've won the weekly tournament at the arena.

story.title: A true friend
story.about: {mentor} wants to see you make a real friend in town, a best friend, before what comes next.

script: them (pleased): So you've made a best friend. Tell me, what did they do to earn that?
player: They stuck around when I lost.
them: That's the kind of friend that counts. I'm proud of you.
them (pleased): Keep them close. What comes next will be harder than this.

scenes.name: World: Story, C1 After the lesson
script: cast guide as {mentor}
background arena
guide enters center with fade
guide: That's the lesson. You played a proper game, and that's all I wanted to see.
player: Was that a good game, then?
guide (lose): Win or lose, you learned the table. Here's 1,500 coins to spend on packs at the shop. Buy a few and see what you get.
guide: When you've won the weekly tournament, come back and find me. I'll want to hear about your friends, too.
guide: The tournament is at the arena. Enter on Saturday, and bring your best deck on Sunday.
player: I'll be there.

scenes.name: World: Story, C1 Champion
script: cast guide as {mentor}
background arena
guide enters center with fade
guide (lose): You won the tournament! Champion of the arena.
player: I did it.
if has_best_friend goto proud
guide: You haven't made a best friend yet, though. That's what I want to see before we take on what's next.
guide: Find someone you really click with. Keep talking to them, give them what they love, and win them over.
player: How long will that take?
guide: As long as it takes. Come back when you've got one, and tell me who.
end
label proud
guide (lose): And you've already got a best friend. I'm proud of you, honestly.
player: Thanks.
guide: Friends are what carry you through this town. Come and tell me who they are.
end

scenes.name: World: Story, C1 Chapter end
script: cast guide as {mentor}
background sakura
guide enters center with fade
guide (lose): A true friend. That's what I was waiting for you to find.
player: What happens now?
guide: The town opens up a little more. There are people who've been waiting to meet you, and a few with questions.
guide (lose): What's coming next is about them. I'll be around if you need me.
player: Thanks, for everything.
guide: That's what friends are for. See you around.

*: narrator: The town square is busy and bright. Nobody here seems to be in a hurry.
narrator: You don't recognise anyone. The sign on the gate is in a language you can read, but the place feels strange.
narrator: A few people are standing around the plaza. Some are chatting, some are reading, one is hitting a training dummy with great enthusiasm.
narrator: You could wander around and hope to work it out. Or you could ask someone.
narrator: You decide to ask someone.
player: Excuse me... where am I?
them: Oh! You're new, {player}, aren't you? I can always tell. Don't worry, it's like this for everyone when they first get here.
player: But where is here?
them: Here is... here. The best place to start. Come on, I'll show you around.

them (pleased): Whoa, you're new! Don't worry, it's like this for everyone when they first get here.

*: them: The people you know decide what you can do and where you can go. Better than being alone here.
them: Let's talk about making friends. You can talk to anyone in town once a day, and each talk helps you get closer.
them: Friendship runs from Stranger, through Acquaintance and Friend, all the way to Best friend.
them: Each step unlocks something, and the best friends have a story to tell.
them: Go on, press Talk and say hello to me.

them (pleased): Friends are the best part of this place! Talk to someone once a day, and you'll get closer to them.
them: Stranger, Acquaintance, Friend, all the way up to Best friend. Each one's a step closer.
them: Go on, press Talk and say hi!

them (pleased): Okay, so, talking! Once a day with anyone, and you get closer. It's like a little café chat.
them: There are ranks, from Stranger all the way to Best friend. Each one's a bit more special.

Asuna Yuuki: them: Before I explain, here's why it matters. The people you know open doors here. Alone, you'd get nowhere.
them: Talking to people is how you make friends. Once a day, with anyone, and each talk brings you closer.
them: The ranks go from Stranger up to Best friend. The closer you get, the more they'll look out for you.
them: Go on, press Talk, and tell me how your day's going.
Erza Scarlet: them: Why this matters: the people you know decide what you can do here. Alone in a strange town, you'd struggle.

*: them: Friends notice what you give them. Gifts are the easiest way to show it.
them: Gifts are the other way in. Everyone loves some things, likes others, and dislikes a few.
them: A loved gift does the most good. A liked one helps. A disliked one can set someone back.
them: You can give each person one gift a day, so make it count.
them: Go on, press Give a gift, and pick something for me.
Aang: them (pleased): Okay, next thing! Gifts are how you show a friend you care.
them (pleased): Here's a tip: I love cute things, and I like sweet and calm ones. Spicy things, not so much!
them: Gifts that someone loves do the most good. Liked ones help. Disliked ones can set someone back.
them: You can give one gift a day to each person. Go on, press Give a gift!

them (pleased): Go on, press Give a gift and surprise me!
Asuna Yuuki: them: Gifts are how you show someone you were thinking of them.
them: A gift is a way of showing you know someone. Loved things do the most good, liked things help, disliked things don't.
them: One gift a day per person. Think about what they'd really enjoy.
them: Go on, press Give a gift, and pick one for me.
Erza Scarlet: them: Gifts show you were paying attention. Friends notice that.

them: One gift a day per person. Do not waste them.
them: Press Give a gift.

*: them: Let's move on. You'll want to find people, so the map comes next.

*: them: Speaking of getting around, the shop is where the cards are.

*: them: Enough shopping. Let's see what people here need from you.
them: Some people in town have quests for you. Look for the ! over someone's head.

*: them: Everything takes time, so let's talk about the clock.
them: Time matters here. Each day has four parts: morning, noon, evening and night.
them: Talking to someone or duelling uses up that part of the day. You can't do it twice.
them: When there's nothing left to do, pass time. The town carries on without you.
them: Go on, press Pass time.
